envelope.description: Accept per-block progress before returning acknowledgment

body.title: Accept per-block progress before returning acknowledgment
body.summary: Implement progress.ts over sc2 pure candidate validation and sc6 object staging/transition append. Bind progress identities, expected sequence, block ownership, receipt replay and uncertainty without implementing durable storage.
acceptanceChecks: Authenticate every progress binding and selected block; reject unsupported evidence, wrong sequence/generation/attempt and conflicting payload identity.
Stage object-valued candidate/transition and append through sc6 before advancing accepted ledger/sequence or returning ACK.
Identical accepted progress returns authoritative prior receipt without reapplying or recharging; missing/lost acceptance stays explicitly uncertain.
Append failure prevents next block assessment; needs-followup/unverified and large-block partial progress retain outstanding work.
Focused delayed-append, lost-ACK, conflict and immutable-state tests pass with test-only in-memory ports.

tests.name: Per-block append-before-ACK, replay and uncertain acceptance
